tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Navy hero at the top of Songs, Playlists and a playlist, Now playing, and the first open screen. Text on it is white or hero-text. White passes 15.7 to 1.

tokens.name: hero-text
tokens.usage: Labels and secondary text on hero, like 24 songs and the artist on Now playing. 9.4 to 1 on hero.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The played part of the progress bar and the shuffle and repeat icons when on. Graphic only, 6.9 to 1 on hero.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Behind the page when a sheet is open, while the page shrinks back. Never text.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Electric blue. Fills only. The main button, the play button, the add button, the selected tab icon. White text on it passes 5.2 to 1.

tokens.name: blue-text
tokens.usage: The only blue for text. The selected tab, the playing song, links, text on soft. 7.5 to 1 on bg, 7.0 on soft.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Soft blue fill. The selected tab pill, the playing row, soft buttons like New playlist. Text on it uses blue-text.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Cover for a song or playlist without its own art, with a primary note on it. 4.1 to 1, graphic only.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen and sheet background. Cool off white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and values. 16.0 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Artists, times, notes, inactive tab. 4.9 to 1 on bg, 5.1 on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders and dividers between rows.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Round grey buttons on light ground, like close and back, and grey note boxes.

tokens.name: chip-text
tokens.usage: Text in a grey note box. 5.6 to 1 on chip.

tokens.name: chevron
tokens.usage: The drag grip and chevrons. 3.4 to 1 on surface.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: The only coral, for destructive actions like Remove from library. 5.9 to 1 on bg, 5.4 on coral-soft.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Behind the remove minus and destructive confirm buttons.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles in the hero and the first open headline.

styles.name: player
styles.usage: The song title on Now playing and the playlist name on its page. The one size between display and section.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Song titles in the mini player, buttons, sheet titles. Same size as body, set apart by weight.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Song titles in lists, field values, menu rows.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Artists, times, counts, notes, tab labels, Up next.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a title and its artist line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a note and the link below it.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a section header and its card, and between art and text in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside rows and cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a sheet.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side margin on every screen and sheet.

tokens.name: radius-art
tokens.usage: Small covers in rows and the mini player.

tokens.name: radius-note
tokens.usage: Grey note boxes and covers in sheets.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, playlist covers, the playlist art.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of sheets and the mini player.

tokens.name: radius-cover
tokens.usage: The big cover on Now playing.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, the tab bar, round buttons. Things you tap.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Things that float over content. The mini player, the tab bar and the add button.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A row while you drag it.

tokens.name: shadow-cover
tokens.usage: The big cover on Now playing.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Height of a full width button.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Height of a song row.

tokens.name: size-art
tokens.usage: Cover in rows and the mini player.

tokens.name: size-mini
tokens.usage: Height of the mini player.

tokens.name: size-fab
tokens.usage: Round add button.

tokens.name: size-play
tokens.usage: Play button on Now playing.

tokens.name: size-round
tokens.usage: Round buttons on the hero.

tokens.name: size-nav-button
tokens.usage: Round close and back buttons in sheets.
